text:
marie: kickoff thread for VelaHealth presales. they expect short marketing spikes ~650 rps for 10m, baseline ~280 rps. question: reserved GPUs vs burst credits and safe autoscale config.

tyler: quick Qs: avg token length? model preference? strict p95 SLA?

marie: avg ~160 tokens, mostly chat, want p95 < 900ms. prefer quant13 but open to fallback.

dia: rough calc: 650 * 160 = 104k tok/s. with KV prefix caching and batching we can cut effective work by ~35-60% for repeat traffic. recommendation: reserve for baseline 280 rps (4-5 GPUs) + burst credits to cover +370 rps.

tyler: propose autoscale envelope: min_replicas 4, max_replicas 13, target ~85 rps/replica, ramp cooldown 30s. include explicit queue depth cap and edge 429 policy.

eng-ops-bot: suggested autoscale json string for proposal: {"min_replicas":"4","max_replicas":"13","target_rps_per_replica":"85","ramp_cooldown_s":"30"}

dia: routing plan: default to quant13, failover to fp16 70B when queue_depth > 60 or p95 exceeds 1s for 45s. document warmup: KV preheat 8-12m prior at 200 rps for 5m.

sec-bot: security note: VelaHealth requires customer KMS + monthly audit export. Dedicated or Private supports full KMS; Hosted offers envelope encryption + logs export. add Private option for PHI.

marie: pricing ask: client wants delta reserved vs on-demand for 12mo. tyler will pull finance quote.

tyler: action items: 1) finance quote for 12mo reserved + burst addon 2) ops to draft POC runbook (preheat, synthetic promo sim, failover) 3) security to prepare KMS appendix. schedule 30m preflight with VelaHealth ops tomorrow.

marie: i'll assemble proposal: reserve 5 GPUs steady, burst credits for +370 rps (10-15m windows), autoscale min4/max13, KV preheat, fallback routing, security appendix. sending draft by EOD.
